metadata.title: systemic-tau-formal: Machine-verifiable Systemic Tau (τₛ) and RECD
metadata.description:
systemic-tau-formal v0.1.12 is an open monorepo for machine-checkable formalization and reproducible reference code of the Systemic Tau (τₛ) paradigm and the Discrete Extramental Clock (RECD).

What is new in v0.1.12 — P1 instrument + multi-domain residual pack

  • P1-Synthetic Canonical v1.0.0: order→chaos plant with planted t_obs; frozen detector w=13, θ_ch=0.41, min_run=4, lead [4,6]; G1–G4 INSTRUMENT_PASS (plant 20/20 hits).
  • C1 companion: false-early-warning stress; C1A/B PASS; C1C FAIL on pure ambient noise (FP rate 1.0) → C1_STRESS_FAIL.
  • Field residual (same freeze): Aedes Vitória external t_obs 0/5; ILI HHS→FluSurv peak 0/10 (p75 1/10); EEG CHB-MIT v1.0/v1.1 pilots archived and paused.
  • Honest synthesis: docs/P1_FAIL_TRIPTYCH.md (instrument PASS · field residual · C1 ambient FAIL). Optional C1 guard design only (docs/P1_C1_GUARD_DESIGN.md) — not implemented.
  • Reproduce: notebooks/16_p1_synthetic_canonical.py run|c1; pytest tests/test_p1_synthetic.py (+ domain suites).

Honesty (do not overclaim)

  • INSTRUMENT_PASS ≠ multi-domain EWS discharge.
  • No dengue / flu / seizure forecasting skill is claimed under the frozen chaos-band rule.
  • CHB-MIT raw EDFs are not redistributed; protocols and locked scores are.

Prior (v0.1.11) still included: Module CT residual pack — pathwise RECD/CT Lean discharge with 0 sorry / 0 research axiom under SystemicTau/.

Companion: PyPI systemictau. Prior corpus DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20576241.

Epistemic honesty: operational thresholds 0.50 / 0.41 remain protocol pins; no continuum thermodynamic axiom is added to Lean.
